Messages.Author: AL
Messages.Body:
Well, I was looking of advanced vampires and was thinking what
vampires are really worth of merging. Below are some comments that are
based to my experience or beliefs.

-Antero

1.Ramona
She is small, and can be used to move blood to and fro, so she can be
merged (but I would not waste Master slots to Gifts of Experience when
both of her versions are in a crypt).

2.Tusk, The Talebearer
A sad minion. Never worth playing :(

3.Alfred Benezri
A merged ability give quite good voting potential on a merged vampire.
Worth of merging (at least in a Storyline).

4.Quentin King III
His special helps older vampires come out faster, but as it is, the 4
transfers and one pool to merge him could be used to put 4 blood to,
say, Fleurdumal. Merged Q.K.III could do some princely
dodge/additional strike/Coma/Amaranth tricks though.

5.Jeremy MacNeil
One of the two vampires that can be Anarchs w/o action or master card.
I have not tried to play him as anarch yet, but will do so if I have
time...

6.Lucita
With all the Ministries flying aroud soon, it could be beneficial to
merge her, to save her from humiliation as some Wah-Young Chen (agh.
Wah Chun-Yuen it was) gets +3 intercept against her...

7.Lazarus
Too big, I think.

8.Tegyrius, Vizier
Definitely worth of merging. Assmaite Justicar...I would not have
believed this before CE...

9.Lambach
Old version is better and has better picture. No merge to him...

10.Marcus Vitel
Same comments as to Lambach.

11.Sela
The new version looks 20 years older (responsibility gives grey hair?)
and merging does not give any essential benefits to her.

12.Sebastian Goulet
Woo-hoo. War Ghouls, Shambling Hordes and Abyssal Hunters look after
his pasty white posterior? Merge him and take the nuisances to you!
Wonderful merged ability.

13.Yong-Sun, Harmonist
The newer player stock seems to be greatly irritated that his
non-advanced version was not in a !Nosferatu starter. I cetainly do
know why, cos merged Young-Sung with Rutor's Hand is quite sick.

14.Jessica
Both of her versions work just fine by themselves, I think.

15.Goratrix
Dunno. I would either play normal or advanced, but as the merging
changes his sect, it could give some problems in deckbuilding.

16.Dominique
Look Comments about Mr. MacNeil. Besides, her picture is nice.

Bonus question: how is Szechenyi Jolan spelled? I would not want to
refer her only as "Mother of Horrors" when I play her...

Advanced vampires have a great bonus: you can put them in your crypt
with their basic version and you don't have to worry about getting 2
copies of the vampire in your crypt. It's often just a safe way of
doubling up on vampires.

I really like merged Ramona. But then I really like Ramona. And
Advanced Ramona. I use both in my all Protean Gangrel bleed deck, and
I'm always happy to get them merged.

>
> 2.Tusk, The Talebearer
> A sad minion. Never worth playing :(

As much as I badmouth poor Tusk, like the next guy, I'm currently
playing a weenie presence bleed/Nosferatu OBF overlords deck that uses
Tusk and Advanced Tusk--the crypt is all 1/2/3's with pre and then
Agripina, Grendel, Tusk, and Advanced Tusk. I only need the OBF, so
his lack of disciplines isn't an issue, I use lots of Nosferatu cards
(Kindred Intel; Patagia), so it is good to have the Nosferatu, and the
merged combo of the two of them is actually pretty good--getting to
see your next card is a surprisingly useful ability, and getting to
burn off uneeded obf cards (like extra disguised weapons)is handy.
Tusk isn't, like, super cool or anything, but Tusk and Merged Tusk
together make a pretty good combo.
the nuisances to you!

version but no reprinted original version, it is going to be hell
trying to get originals.

-Peter

> assamite!

As I wrote that Tegyrius is worth merging, it was my personal opinion
because although Assamite Justicar deck hard to come by, it is very
nice to play with Assamites when:
1. you have no fear that your main star is PTO'd.
2. your vampires can bounce
3. your main star cannot be the victim of Kiss of Ra
4. you can play Parity Shift and other nice cards
...and so on...except if Tegyrius falls, you are as good as dead :(

As it is, I'm afraid that the my Tegyrius decks fall into the fun
category. I usually keep no decklists, but the last Teg Deck had
AUS/CEL/FOR intercept/combat, with some P/J actions/reactions/votes,
and token princes Volker and Rake. It did OK, but I assume that if
*really good and competitive* Tegyrius decks exist, it could be found
from The Path of Blood (www.thepathofblood.com).

-Antero
